# Developer Documentation

We maintain a few developer documentation pages:

* [Snapshots Database](./snapshots-database.md): See this document for descriptions of our database tables, columns, and relationships.
* [Snapshots Dataflows](./snapshots-dataflows.md): Contains diagrams showing how our APIs are used to service requests from dotcom and dg-api.
* [Glossary](./glossary.md): See this document for precise definitions of terms used in this documentation and in the code itself.
* [Dependency Snapshots Service](./dependency-snapshots-service.md): Contains background information about the service, its intended use, and ideas for future work.
* [Azure](./azure.md): General doc about azure specific aspects of ds-api
